mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates signal weak labor market conditions that lead to reduced corporate profits and lower equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their previous month's level, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production, manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (as measured by RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates and low inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a stable monetary environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST below 1000) signal a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.
